capital/theater/mercenary.about-after-war: You were military ? Must've been useful to survive, after the megaspells.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-after-war-answer:
I guess it was. Especially when you have to survive amongst poneys who hate what you became. Ghouls aren't very popular, these days.
I've been traveling a lot, in the beginning. I could manage. I did try to join communities. I even was a mercenary at the Novaran Pikes, for some time. That's southward. But even that didn't work out. This is the only place people leave me in peace.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-before-war:
It was fucking noisy. That I remember. It hadn't always been that way, but everything changed so fast near the end. Trains, factories. Radios, machines making noise all day long. Even at night, there was always some noise somewhere. It's much better now, if you want my honest opinion. Or maybe that's what I'm telling myself to cope.

There were poneys. So many poneys. You could walk through a town and not recognize a single face. Sounds silly, huh ? That's what I miss the most. I miss the silly things.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-current-occupation: I'm wetting my whistle, can't you see ? Just yanking your chain. I don't really do much here. I guess I'm standing guard.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-dangers: Nothing that's dangerous to us, at least for now. But lately, the feral have been even more active than usual. Seems like something is driving them out from the more urban areas.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-fell-shadow-knights: Really ? You're tougher than you look. That must've been quite a fight. Anyway, good job. Feral ghouls aren't much of a threat to us, they tend to ignore us, but I guess I should thank you for making this place a bit safer.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-feral-ghouls: Well, if I was a feral ghoul, nothing would separate me from your brains, right now, especially after such a stupid question.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-feralization: And you're asking me ? How the heck should I know ?
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-ghouls: Not all ghouls. But many. All those that live here, for starters. And probably most of the mindless ones roaming around town.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/about-weapon-skills: I take it you know your stuff as well ? Yeah, I received military training. Not many can boast about that these days, on account that the army doesn't exist no more.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/drink-offered:
That's more like it.

He waves to the barmaid, order two drinks and lets you pay.

So, what did you want to talk about ?
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/drink-offered-name: The name's {{npc}}. That all you wanted to ask ?
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/intro: You're talking to the wrong ghoul. If you want somepony to tell you stories, go bother Broken Lens instead.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-self/prompt-more-questions: I don't talk on a dry throat, and my drink is empty. How about you offer me an other first ?
capital/theater/mercenary.about-town/broken-lens/intro: Broken Lens ? He's got a problem with people's intimacy. Mine in particular. Always peeping, always talking. I enjoy tranquility. He doesn't.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-welcome: Not always. I have to take breaks to sleep every once in a while.
capital/theater/mercenary.about-welcome-2: Nope, I absolutely couldn't ! My poor old ma' didn't raise no liar !
capital/theater/mercenary.about-welcome-exit: Alright. I'll just go bother somepony else then.
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-before-war: What were things like, before the war ?
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-broken-lens: You've got something against Broken Lens ?
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-current-occupation: I wanted to know what you were doing here.
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-dangers: Are there a lot of threats to hold away ?
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-feral-ghoul-2: I'm sorry, I didn't mean it that way. I just wondered why some ghouls turned feral, and others didn't.
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-feral-ghouls: What separates you all from the feral ghouls ?
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-ghouls: I'm curious about ghouls. Is it true you were alive before the war ?
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-self: I just wanted to meet you.
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-about-weapon-skills: I'm not surprised. You look like you know how to handle that rifle.
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-mecenary-join: Ever think about picking up the mercenary gig? I could use some help out there.
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-mercenary-name: What's your name, by the way ?
capital/theater/mercenary.ask-more-politeness: You could at least try to act likeable.
capital/theater/mercenary.entry: Here's the new face. I don't like new.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job-convince: Come on. You don't look like the type to just sit around all day. There's still plenty of things to see out there. Your adventuring days are not over. Who cares if the people outside don't like what you are ? You don't need their approval. Come with me, and just be who you are.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job-decline: Actually, never mind. That's a bit steep for me.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job-negotiate: Any chance you'd cut me a deal on the price ?
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job/accept:
Pleasure doing business.
The name's {{npc}}, seeing as we're gonna be spending some time together. Don't slow me down out there.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job/convince-accept:
Okay, okay, stop talking. Damn it. Fine, you win. I'm coming with you, and I'm not even gonna charge you a single cap for it. Don't make me regret it.

The name's {{npc}}, by the way. Try to remember it.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job/intro: Maybe. It's not like me to sit on my flank for too long. And you seem like a good person. I'm not gonna risk my neck for free though. I'm expensive. 5000 caps, and I have your back.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job/lack-reputation: Maybe someday. But I don't work with people I don't trust. And I don't know you. Prove me you're a good pony, and I'll consider it.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job/negotiate-accept:
Ha ! You've got some nerve, haggling with a ghoul holding a rifle. Alright, 3000 caps, and we call it even.
The name's {{npc}}. Try not to get me killed.
capital/theater/mercenary.mercenary-job/negotiate-refuse: Nice try. 5000 caps, that's the price. I didn't survive two hundred years by doing charity work.
capital/theater/mercenary.no-more-questions: I think we covered it all. See you another time !
capital/theater/mercenary.offer-a-drink: Well, how about taking a break to have a drink with me ?
capital/theater/mercenary.offer-a-drink-2: I'd rather talk with somepony that holds their liquor. Fancy a drink ? I'm paying.
capital/theater/mercenary.tell-about-fell-shadow-knights: Some mutant creatures were frightening them away, but I took them all down. It should calm down.
